en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a large formal garden or park with a variety of trees, palm-like plants, and landscaped flower beds. There is a decorative fountain or planter in the center of the image. The photo caption at the bottom is written in Bulgarian Cyrillic and German, identifying the place as a park in Varna. The reverse side contains handwritten text in blue ink, an address, and a sender's name, as well as a stamp in Cyrillic script.
